card.name: Start of management steps after CDAD warning
card.fires_on: The word starting a management or treatment instruction, mostly the 'ropriate' in 'Appropriate' after the C. difficile (CDAD/CDI) warning. Also the comma or verb that leads into a treatment step.

modes.label: Appropriate after CDAD
modes.description: The 'ropriate' part of 'Appropriate' opening the fluid and electrolyte management sentence after the C. difficile warning.
modes.example: App<<ropriate>> fluid and electrolyte management, protein supplementation

modes.label: Verb leading into treatment
modes.description: A verb or comma that introduces the next care step, such as starting or initiating treatment.
modes.example: Protect the patient's airway, establish an intravenous line and<< initiate>> gastric decontamination.

card.writes: The promoted words are about cords and isolation while risk and safety words are suppressed, so there is no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the word that begins a 'what to do next' care instruction, especially after a C. difficile warning.
